title: Pure Mist B+L 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist B+L delivers the authentic, earthy taste of traditional tobacco with a smooth and mellow profile. Perfect for those seeking a classic tobacco flavour reminiscent of cigarettes, this e-liquid provides a familiar and satisfying vaping experience. As part of the Pure Mist High-PG collection, this e-liquid is available in a variety of VG/PG ratios to suit different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour and discreet vapour. Crafted for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits and starter vape kits, Pure Mist B+L is an ideal choice for adult smokers transitioning to vaping. Made in the UK with premium ingredients, this e-liquid ensures consistent quality and flavour.
